title: The musl target needs crt-static disabled to emit a cdylib

notes: musl defaults to crt-static and a cdylib cannot be linked statically, so cargo emits nothing rather than failing. Only the guard on an empty output caught it

title: npm publish needs a ./ prefix or it reads the path as a git repository
evidence: Run 34174483038: npm publish platform-packages/darwin-arm64 ran git ls-remote ssh://git@github.com/platform-packages/darwin-arm64.git and failed on the public key. The dry run never caught it because it packs rather than publishes
notes: A bare relative path is a git shorthand to npm. Only the publish step uses a loop variable, so this class of bug cannot appear in the pack step that the dry run exercises
